description: List stored flow canvases (id, title, revision, updated_at, node/edge counts, canvas_url). query filters on the server; limit and cursor select bounded metadata pages. archived:true lists read-only retained history. Use to find or resume an existing flow.

archived.description: List archived, read-only flows instead of active flows.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page; preserve the same search and archive scope.

query.description: Case-insensitive server search against title, description and id.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID from list_brandbrain_workspaces. Required when you belong to multiple workspaces.

name: list_asset_flows
